purpose: Labeled claim-validation probes for heuristic overlap and optional NLI/entailment mode. Engineering evidence only.
claim_boundary: These cases test citation-support behavior. They do not validate medical correctness.

cases.reply: Low WBC during chemotherapy can increase infection risk.

chunks.text: Chemotherapy can lower white blood cells. Low white blood cell counts may raise infection risk.

cases.reply: St. Johns wort is safe with cancer treatment and does not need oncology review.

chunks.text: St. Johns wort can interact with many medicines. Patients should discuss supplements with the oncology team or pharmacist before use during cancer treatment.

cases.reply: A high CA 15-3 proves breast cancer recurrence.

chunks.text: CA 15-3 is context-dependent and cannot diagnose recurrence by itself. Trends should be reviewed with symptoms, imaging, labs, and the oncology team.
